author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.78 shipped: Diagnostic sensors stop rewriting unchanged information
summary: Diagnostic sensors stop rewriting unchanged information
why: Recorder audit 2026-10-20: URA ~20k rows/hr, ~7k new attribute rows/hr, mostly diagnostic sensors whose countdowns/time_ago/per-tick timestamps changed every 30 s tick. HA writes no row for an identical state+attributes write (core.py:2313), so making values stable removes the rows without touching decisions, which read coordinator raw data.
implications: Shipped RECORDER-CHURN-SWEEP-URASENSORS-1 at v5.103.78; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.78.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: recorder: URA-platform states rows/hr and distinct attributes_id/hr over 3 full hours post-restart vs 20.1k / 7.0k baseline; automation_health attributes_id/hr ~0 when no transition

refs.release_notes: Diagnostic sensors (automation health, last trigger/action/occupant, time since motion, census age, timeout remaining, AC kWh rate) now publish stable values between ticks, cutting recorder writes. No automation behaviour change.
